boundary_cases.scope: Press/release menu ancestry, empty-space clicks, cross-boundary gestures and cancelled pointer state

installation.qualification_scope: Development installation of popover outside dismissal and press/release boundaries; core, sanitizer, native, sample and export checks pass.
installation.timing_profiles: Timing profiles are from build 196 and lifecycle results from build 195; neither requalifies this binary. Development install only.

timing_budget.policy: Every measured run must meet every p95 time limit; no averaging away failures.

definition.name: Frontier development desktop CPU targets
definition.description: Provisional engineering targets for this measured RTX 5080 development machine, manual updates, static scene, 1280x720. Adapter matching does not identify the CPU or certify other hardware. CPU API timings exclude total GPU/UI cost.

timing_budget.policy: Every measured run must meet every p95 time limit; no averaging away failures.

definition.name: Frontier development desktop automatic 3D targets
definition.description: Provisional engineering targets chosen before measurement: 60 FPS whole-scene p95 at1080p, with existing UI API limits and corresponding cumulative core limits. Automatic updates include deferred core work. Whole-frame measurements include the scene and scheduling; these limits do not isolate UI cost or certify other hardware.

timing_budget.policy: Every measured run must meet every p95 time limit; no averaging away failures.

definition.name: Frontier development desktop automatic 4K 3D targets
definition.description: Same per-workload limits and 60 FPS combined-scene target as the 1080p automatic 3D profile, at 3840x2160 on the development RTX 5080. Not lower-end hardware certification or isolated UI/GPU overhead.

next: 4K frame delays remain unexplained after the same-export placement diagnostic. Continue runtime attribution and remaining game UI behavior requirements, including select explicit/intrinsic sizing.

load_conclusion.interpretation: All failures concern combined scene frame intervals in the mobile renderer. UI-disabled failures prevent attributing the cause to UI alone. API timing gates pass; the whole-frame failures remain failures.
load_conclusion.next_investigation: After lifecycle finishes, compare the same exported 4K scene with UI disabled and enabled while recording renderer/GPU conditions. Preserve this qualification and its unchanged budgets.

presentation_diagnostic.conclusion: Offscreen and onscreen frame p95 ranges overlap (12.099–13.487 versus 12.316–13.461 ms). This does not establish placement as the cause of prior 4K failures. Original failures remain unchanged.
